content: The first day moves from August 13 in 2025–26 to August 12 in 2026–27, and the last day moves from June 12 to June 11.
The three trimester-ending minimum days move to October 30, March 5 and June 4; each falls one calendar day earlier than the corresponding 2025–26 date.
Thanksgiving, Winter and Spring recesses keep the same weekday pattern but begin one calendar date earlier than in 2025–26.

comparisonTitle: MVUSD 2026–27 Calendar Compared With Nearby Districts
comparisonSummary: MVUSD and Pomona both start August 12. Pomona ends May 28, two weeks before MVUSD’s June 11 last day; Riverside and San Bernardino use different opening and ending dates.
comparisonFooterText: Dates follow each district’s reviewed 2026–27 calendar. Riverside’s last student day varies by grade, from May 26 to May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Moreno Valley Unified calendar does this page cover?
calendarFaqs.a: This page covers MVUSD’s 2026–27 calendar for grades TK–6 and TK–5 at Butterfield Language Academy. Use the calendar selector near the top of the page for preschool, Head Start, grades 6–8, or grades 9–12.

calendarFaqs.q: When does MVUSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students on the grades TK–6/TK–5 Butterfield calendar return Wednesday, August 12, 2026. Other grades and programs use separate official calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MVUSD Winter Recess in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: On the calendar summarized here, Winter Recess runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 8, 2027. Students return Monday, January 11.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MVUSD Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: On the calendar summarized here, Spring Recess runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students return Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of instruction for MVUSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The grades TK–6/TK–5 Butterfield calendar ends Friday, June 11, 2027. It is a minimum day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does MVUSD publish separate calendars for middle and high school?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. MVUSD publishes separate 2026–27 calendars for grades 6–8, including Butterfield grades 6–8, and for grades 9–12.
